headline: Omega Sherro
title: Omega Sherro | Beat It to Evolve Sherro | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Omega Sherro is the Water boss you must beat to evolve Sheldon into Sherro. Finish the Stars and the Knight quest at Echoback Landing, then fight it. The boss is around level forty. Grass, Lightning and Ice hit it for one point six times damage, while Fire, Water, Earth and Dark are resisted. Thornblade is a strong Grass pick. Sheldon also needs level thirty nine. Ready to fight it? Comment below!
description: Omega Sherro boss tips in Aniimo: a Water boss near level 40, weak to Grass, Lightning and Ice (1.6x). Defeating it unlocks Sheldon's level 39 evolution into Sherro.
